content.title: University website pe?
content.subtitle: Brochure nahi, course ka page sabse zaroori hai.

steps.title: Eligibility
steps.detail: Kaunsi degree, kitne marks aur kaunsa background chahiye. Ye pehle padho, baaki baad mein.

steps.title: English test requirement
steps.detail: Kaunsa test chalega aur minimum score kya hai. Har course ka alag ho sakta hai.

steps.title: Deadlines
steps.detail: Application, scholarship aur deposit, teeno ki dates alag hoti hain. Calendar mein daal do.
steps.tip: Timezone bhi dekho. Unki raat, hamari subah ho sakti hai.

steps.title: Course modules
steps.detail: Naam pe mat jao. Kaunse subjects padhaye jaate hain, wo dekho.

steps.title: Fees aur funding page
steps.detail: Tuition ke saath baaki kharche bhi wahi likhe hote hain. Scholarships ka link bhi aksar wahin milta hai.
steps.tip: Course Finder pe fees pehle compare kar lo.

caption:
University ki website pe kho jaate ho? Course page pe ye 5 cheezein pehle dekho 👇

1. Eligibility
2. English test requirement
3. Deadlines
4. Course modules
5. Fees aur funding

Save karo 📌 aur us dost ko bhejo jise iski zaroorat hai.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com
